title: Hornbill nest lockdown skit
storyboard: Film: one actor plays both hornbills: behind a cardboard 'mud wall' with a slit, then passing fruit in
caption:
Nesting season, but make it a lockdown.

After the eggs hatch, the female breaks out of the nest, and the chicks may be walled in again. Indian grey hornbills and Oriental pied hornbills (in the clip) both nest in tree cavities like this.
